pkgmetadata.longdescription: A fork of PCSX2 adding speedrun and practice tooling. Installs its executable as pcsx2-reliquary-qt and its resources under /usr/share/pcsx2-reliquary, so it can be installed alongside games-emulation/pcsx2.

use.flag: Build with llvm-core/clang, which is the only compiler upstream supports
Enable support for the media-sound/sndio backend
